title: Michaela historical teaching staff register
scope: Public-source reconstruction, not a complete employee census. First and last evidence are not employment start/end dates. Empty fields mean not established, never unqualified or unemployed.
recovery: Restored from the original research outputs, which recorded 85 entries and 117 source records. This published dataset retains the 85 entries and a curated source index; it does not assert 85 distinct qualified teachers. Four entries are teaching fellows, twelve are surname-only, and possible duplicate identities are flagged.
records: French/Philosophy are degree and earlier teaching fields, not a verified current teaching timetable. CBE is an honour, not a qualification.
